`page2.json` is the unmodified Quran.com public API response retrieved 2026-10-13:
https://api.quran.com/api/v4/verses/by_page/2?mushaf=1&words=true&word_fields=code_v2,text_qpc_hafs,page_number,line_number&per_page=50

Used to verify physical word/line grouping against the canonical Tanzil verse identifiers. QCF V2 glyphs belong to King Fahd Quran Complex. Runtime fonts are downloaded from Quran Foundation; fonts are not bundled in this fixture.
